                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               1/2

NOTE. - The North-eastern Superintendency of New Brunswick includes the Micmacs of the counties on the north-east of that province. The 1st division of the South-western Superintendency of that province embraces the Amalecites of all the counties on the south and west sides of the province,
except Victoria and Madawaska, which form the 2nd division of the superintendency. [j 44 bush. of garden produce.] [k 6 bush. of apples.] [l 3 barns and stables.] [m Potatoes eaten as soon as grown.] [n 4 barns and stables.] [o Some oats sown but no return give.] [p Some carrots and turnips were
grown in small garden patches but no return given.] [q 23 barns and stables.] [r 20 barns and stables. [*77 oxen and bulls.] [(t)Agent has no means of estimating.] [(tt)Agent unable to make estimate of crops raised.] [*See note "n".] [(t)See note "q".] [(tt)See note "r."] [(tt)Some sown but no return
given.] [(ss)Some planted but no return given.]
